letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Junior Software Engineer position with Example Hiring Team. I am a software engineer with a BSc in Computer Science and hands-on experience building Node.js services, testing booking logic, and improving accessible user workflows.

During my internship at Example Studio, I built appointment-conflict validation in a Node.js API and added regression tests for overlapping bookings. I also replaced an inaccessible date picker with a keyboard-operated booking flow after testing it with the product team. This work strengthened my interest in reliable APIs and interfaces that are straightforward for people to use.

I have continued developing these skills through Booking Lab, an independent appointment scheduler built with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. The project includes persistent storage and automated tests for booking conflicts. I documented the tradeoff between database constraints and application validation and created a reproducible local demo. Together, these experiences have taught me to think carefully about correctness, testability, and clear implementation choices.

I would bring a practical foundation in the technologies named in your role, along with curiosity and a willingness to learn. My record does not yet include Kubernetes operations, so I would approach that area as a development priority and be candid about where I need guidance. I value teams that review work closely, share operational knowledge, and treat accessibility and testing as part of engineering quality.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my API testing, React development, accessibility work, and project experience could contribute to your team. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Zoë Șerban
